notes: «قال عمرو أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا ابن وهب» : the verbs differ («أخبرنا» / «حدثنا») but the three meet at ابن وهب, so it is one route with one level of three.
«أخبرني عمرو» is the third occurrence of the word in the text; it is Ibn Wahb's own source and is not identified with عمرو بن سواد here.
«بكيرا» is written in the accusative as in the text.
